tasks.title: voice timbres by GM program
tasks.prompt: Match surrounding style. Change only the allowed files. No new dependencies. Add optional named param `int? program` to addVoice (default null). When null or outside the ranges below, output must stay bit-identical to today. Ranges (GM zero-based): 16..23 organ = harmonics 1..6 equal-ish weights 1/n with NO decay and 0.01 s attack; 56..63 brass = harmonics 1..8 weights 1/n with 0.04 s attack; 88..95 pad = existing bowed timbre but 0.15 s attack; 8..15 mallet/bell = partials 1 and 2.76 with exp(-t*6) decay.
